content.text: Profile & Record Next fight News Results Potential fights Stream Tickets Discuss Stats Full record Ranking @ Heavyweight Arslanbek Makhmudov profile What is Arslanbek Makhmudov's Record? Arslanbek Makhmudov's record currently stands at 21 wins, 3 losses, and 0 draws. Of those 21 wins, he has stopped 19 of his opponents, so his current knock-out ratio is 90%. Of his 3 losses, he's been stopped 2 times. He's boxed a total of 81 rounds, meaning his professional fights last 3.4 rounds on average. When was his last fight and how active is he? Arslanbek Makhmudov's last fight took place against Tyson Fury on April 11, 2026, in London, United Kingdom. He lost by unanimous decision after 12 rounds. That fight was 5 days ago. Makhmudov's last 5 fights have come over a period of 2 years, 5 months and 14 days, meaning he has been fighting on average every 5 months and 28 days. In those fights, he fought a total of 27 rounds, meaning that they have lasted 5.4 rounds on average. How Old Is Arslanbek Makhmudov And Where Is he From? The heavyweight is currently 36 years old. He was born on June 7, 1989, so he will turn 37 in 1 month and 22 days. Makhmudov was born in Russia. How long has Makhmudov been fighting? Arslanbek Makhmudov made his professional debut in April 2018, so he has been a pro for 8 years. How good is he? Makhmudov is currently ranked 5th by the WBA and 20th by Box.Live at Heavyweight. How tall is Makhmudov, What is his Reach And Which Stance Does he Use? Makhmudov is 6' 6" tall, which is 197cm. His reach is 77.6 inches, which is 197 cm. Makhmudov fights from a traditional orthodox stance, which means he favours his right hand as his power hand when fighting. What are some potential opponents for Arslanbek Makhmudov? Some potential future fights for Makhmudov include Anthony Joshua and Junior Fa. What will be Arslanbek Makhmudov's Next Fight And Where Can I Watch It? Arslanbek Makhmudov doesn't currently have a fight scheduled. Some potential future fights for Makhmudov include Anthony Joshua and Junior Fa. In the UK you can usually stream Makhmudov's fights on Netflix. In the US you can usually stream Arslanbek Makhmudov's fights via Netflix. What are some recent Arslanbek Makhmudov results? Makhmudov has beaten 2 of his last 5 opponents, stopping 1 of them, going the distance once. In his last fight, he lost to Tyson Fury on April 11, 2026, by unanimous decision in their 12 round contest at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, London, United Kingdom. Prior to that, he had won against Dave Allen on October 11, 2025, by unanimous decision in their 12 round contest at Sheffield Arena, Sheffield. Going into that contest, he had been beaten by Guido Vianello on August 17, 2024, by technical knockout in the 8th round at Centre Videotron, Quebec City, Canada. Before that, he had beaten Miljan Rovcanin on May 25, 2024, by knockout in the 2nd round at Centre Gervais Auto, Shawinigan. He had lost to Agit Kabayel on December 23, 2023, by technical knockout in the 4th round at KINGDOM ARENA, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
